They are recorded as separate typed entries because the scenario_location layout is not recovered in this artifact; when that struct is recovered these two entries should be replaced by a single nested member.
position (+0x1c) and velocity (+0x28) are contiguous and together fill +0x1c..+0x33, leaving no hole before next_index at +0x34.

MSVC STACK-OVERLAP HAZARD at the write site (lift-learnings section 2): the position copy at contrails.c:405-407 reads the creation marker buffer at marker+0x60, which in the original MSVC frame overlapped a separate local. Do not 'simplify' that copy when converting these offsets to field access.
